sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's >>= operator silently propagates Nothing through a chain of computations, so if any step yields Nothing, the entire result is Nothing without any explicit check.
sketches.resonance: One absence anywhere in a sequence of connections erases everything that could have followed — the way a single loss can hollow out a whole future.
sketches.draft:
absence :: Maybe a
absence = Just () >>= \_ ->
         Just () >>= \_ ->
         Nothing  >>= \_ ->
         Just ()

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference automatically becomes nil when the object it references is deallocated — the runtime silently erases the connection without notifying the holder.
sketches.resonance: You can hold someone weakly and one day find they have simply become nil, with no warning, no farewell — only the empty optional remains.

sketches.mechanism: method_missing is called when an object receives a message it does not understand — it can respond to anything, even calls that were never defined.
sketches.resonance: Answering every call even when you have no real method for it: the exhaustion of those who refuse to say they don't know how.
sketches.draft:
class Pleaser
  def method_missing(name, *)
    method_missing(name, *)
  end
end
Pleaser.new.anything
